raw_segments.text: Omen, omen. The dictionary. If the gods think to speak outright to man, they will honorably
speak outright, not shake their heads and give an old wives' darkling hint. Begone.
Ye too are the opposite poles of one thing. Starbuck is stub-reversed and stub is starbuck.
And ye too are all mankind. And Ahab stands alone among the millions of the peopled earth,
nor gods nor men his neighbors. Cold, cold, I shiver. How now, aloft there, do ye see
Sing out for every spout, though he spout ten times a second.
